summary.en: At 11:30 during a bird watching trip, Kogoro, Ran, and Conan see a suspicious person looking around before going to his truck containing two electric appliances through binoculars, but Conan points out something that suggests their detective work is not going to be put on hold.

locations: Shiro Kurotaki's house, Kitaokuho, Tokyo Prefecture

victims.name: Shiro Kurotaki
victims.causeOfDeath: Blood loss from stab wound on the chest

suspects: Orie Shoyama, Takuro Shoyama, Sosuke Yumemura and Akihiro Kurotaki
